articles.title: Palmer Luckey’s Anduril is getting into laptops — and claims they’ll be American-made
articles.description: BlueChip will be an Arm-based laptop from an arms dealer. | Image: Anduril Anduril and Qualcomm are partnering on a new line of laptops called BlueChip, launching in early 2027. The first prototype is a ruggedized model using Arm-based Snapdragon X series chips and aimed at the US military, but the ultimate focus of the joint venture is to make laptops entirely in the US. Eventually. The global supply chain of computers and laptops normally involves China, Taiwan, and many other countries, so the first BlueChip laptops will only be "designed and assembled in the United States," per Anduril's official press release.
